Facts: Heir challenged alleged indirect donation to nephew, seeking reduction for infringement of legitimate share without prior acceptance of inheritance with benefit of inventory.
Legal Framework: Action for reduction (Art. 553-564 Italian Civil Code); acceptance with benefit of inventory (Art. 564 Civil Code); simulation of contracts (Art. 1414-1417 Civil Code).
Interpretative Issues: Whether an heir who simply and purely accepted the inheritance may bring an action for reduction of an alleged donation made to a non-heir without prior acceptance with benefit of inventory.
Legal Principles: When an heir brings an action to ascertain simulation concealing a donation for the sole purpose of subsequent reduction, Art. 564 Civil Code requires prior acceptance with benefit of inventory. This requirement applies when the alleged donation was made to a non-co-heir. The heir is not pretermitted if appointed heir by will, thus acceptance with benefit of inventory is mandatory. Without such acceptance, the action is inadmissible.
